svg.aria-label: VULCAN. Forge your physique. An AI-native fitness app for Android. Workout tracking, AI coaching, food photo analysis, physique analysis and a step-driven calorie budget, personalized to every user. Built with Expo, FastAPI, Supabase and Gemini. 8 of 8 build phases done.
